title: Addendum 11 deviation record D11-1, version 2 (amends version 1; written before any probe result)

amends.status: superseded by this version; kept unchanged

state_when_written.note: GPU residual capture in progress (11/432 units at the time of the decision); the probe step has never run

change_vs_v1: Control rows (gold tokens of a random other paper; of a random same-field paper) for the per-donor (Vpd) primary analysis are computed per false title and averaged over the SAME usable false-title set as the main Vpd result (previously only the 5-title average ctrl_*5 was available).
reason: The main result and its controls must use the same false-title set; mixing a per-donor main result with 5-title-average controls would let title-reuse leakage enter the controls only. User decision 2026-11-08 (option b).
implementation: CPU only: the probe step already computes per-title control scores (stage13_b2_np_probe.py:146–147) but discarded them; a new probe version stores ctrl_*_f0..f4 (and true) per paper; the v2 report forms Vpd controls with the per-paper usable-title mask. No new GPU forwards; the 11 completed GPU units need no recomputation.
hard_check: On the tiny data and on 1 real shard, the V0 and V5x0 tables (including control rows) from the new probe/report must equal the old ones exactly (max |diff| = 0); otherwise stop. The report lists the usable-title distribution separately for the Vpd main result and the Vpd control rows and checks they are identical.
everything_else: as version 1 (primary Vpd; V0 and V5x0 'contains leakage, sensitivity only' reported beside)
